findings.location: source.html — section with James 3:13-18 (long block quoted in English)
findings.source_quote: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom. But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth. This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish. For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work. But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy. And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace. –James 3:13-18.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the entire quoted James 3:13–18 passage into Russian, using the conventional book name and keeping the verse range identical. Example: «Кто из вас мудр и разумен, покажи делами своими в кротости мудрости; а если у вас зависть горькая и внутренняя ссора, то не хвалитесь и не лгите против истины. Такая мудрость не с высоты нисходит, но земная, душевная, бесовская. Ибо где зависть и ссора, там смутa и всякое худое дело; а мудрость, с высоты, прежде чиста, затем мирна, кротка, легко податлива, полна милосердия и добрых плодов, беспристрастна и не лицемерна. Плод праведности сеется в мире теми, кто сеет мир» — Иаков 3:13-18. Preserve the <em> or <strong> tags if present around portions of the quotation.

But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy. And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace. –James 3:13-18.

findings.location: source.html — multiple inline Scripture references left in English form (examples: 1 Timothy 4:14, 1 Corinthians 12:24-25, 1 Corinthians 14:22, 2 Corinthians 12:7-12)
findings.source_quote: Instances throughout the translation where Scripture references or small quoted clauses remain in English, e.g. "–1 Timothy 4:14.", "(1 Corinthians 12:24-25)", "–1 Corinthians 14:22.", "(2 Corinthians 12:7-12)" and small quoted clauses such as "…the laying on of the hands of the presbytery –1 Timothy 4:14."
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure all quoted Scripture text (even brief clauses) is translated into Russian and use conventional Russian book names (1 Тимофею, 1 Коринфянам, 2 Коринфянам, etc.), keeping chapter:verse numbers exactly the same. Also translate short quoted phrases that are part of Scripture (e.g. "the laying on of the hands of the presbytery") into Russian while preserving punctuation and HTML. Example: «…возложением рук пресвитерского сословия — 1 Тимофею 4:14.»
